questions.question: To what is the blessed man compared?
options: A wall built on solid rock
A lamp set on a high stand
A tree planted by streams of water
A spring of water in a dry desert land
questions.answer: A tree planted by streams of water

questions.question: To what are the wicked compared?
options: Dew that fades in the morning sun
Stubble burned up in the fire
Chaff that the wind drives away
questions.answer: Chaff that the wind drives away
